faqs.a:
Section AF103.1 General,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
AF103.1. General.
The following construction techniques are intended to resist radon entry and prepare
                  new buildings containing dwelling units for post-construction radon mitigation, if
                  necessary (see Figure AF103). These techniques are required throughout the City of
                  Arvada."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
